items.title: Strategic Communications Consultant
items.subtitle: Freelance (full-time engagement with client)
items.content:
Full-time consulting role supporting a U.S.-based national membership organization on digital strategy, content operations, and platform improvement. Strengthen systems, workflows, and analytics to enhance organization-wide digital communications.

**Key Contributions:**
- Improved web, email, social, and multimedia platforms to enhance clarity, usability, and engagement.
- Built and refined workflows, dashboards, and reporting tools to enable coordinated, data-driven decisions.
- Delivered CMS development, technical troubleshooting, and maintenance for large, high-traffic digital properties.
- Advised teams on governance, best practices, and operational efficiency across digital functions.

items.title: Director of Digital Media
items.subtitle: National Association of Counties
items.content:
Led the digital communications function for a national membership and policy organization, managing a team of four, the communications budget, and all digital channels. Directed digital strategy, platform modernization, multi-channel content delivery, and organization-wide workflows, analytics, and governance.

**Key Achievements:**
- Oversaw full redesign and migration of a 10,000+ page Drupal website, coordinating across teams and vendors.
- Built and managed a broadcast-quality video studio for weekly and event-based productions.
- Developed content governance systems, project workflows, and cross-department standards.
- Expanded analytics and reporting using GA4, MS Clarity, Power BI, Looker Studio, BigQuery.
- Directed multi-channel communications aligned with national advocacy priorities.
- Strengthened long-term planning, team development, and organizational coordination.
